**Three Options Presented:**
- **Option A (7/7 - 100%):** Strict - require all criteria verified before Phase 2 entry
- **Option B (5/7 - 71%):** Lenient - accept 5 verified criteria and proceed to Phase 2
- **Option C (6/7 - 86%):** Balanced - reassess after 5/7 verification, decide based on what's missing

**Product Owner Recommendation:**
- ❌ **REJECT Option B** - Shipping without 60 FPS violates SRS core performance promise
- ✅ **SUPPORT Option C** - BUT ONLY if criterion #1 (60 FPS) is verified or has clear resolution timeline
